levels.surface: يحيى بن عبد الرحمن بن حاطب
عبد الله بن الزبير بن العوام

notes: «عن أبيه» has the father as a relation, and the saying then names the speaker «قال الزبير يا رسول الله». The text writes one man there, so the reading gives one link («الزبير», the speaker) and not a separate relation; whether the two are one link is for ruling.
«أما إنه سيكون» is the Prophet's answer; the Prophet is the end.
